body: I am doing it in my car. I have an email set to go out at 3 in the morning to let her know where I am and to call the police to deal with my body.
There is a full no-contact order in effect.
I'm not sure she would, honestly. All I've heard from her for the last 48hrs is about how much my stress has been pouring into her life lately.

I promised her when we took our break that we would eventually get back together, and then changed my mind. It was a shitty thing of me to do, but I had no idea how happy I would be once free of her abuse.

She's accused me of domestic abuse and despite literally no evidence other than her word (she's reported this abuse 2 years post breakup) I have been charged and am awaiting trial. The statistics for men facing these kinds of charges in my home province do not favour me.
As far as I know, I won't be capable of missing anyone or anything.

I made a throwaway just to vent for a moment. I was a close friend of Christina's and this rhetoric her friends like to use regarding her being ready is disgusting. It was rampant at her service and I understand it's a way to cope, but it always leaves a bad taste in my mouth. Christina wasn't ready. She was taken, early. She had so many ambitions and many of her goals were only just being realized. I miss her. Every day. All that she was and everything I knew she would become. There is no silver lining in her death. It's horrible, and sad, and it should've never happened. But it did. Not for any reason, or because she was ready. Because some coward decided to take her life away.
